scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const html=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8');const start=html.indexOf('<script>');const end=html.lastIndexOf('</script>');if(start<0||end<0||end<=start)throw new Error('Inline script tidak ditemukan');const js=html.slice(start+8,end);new Function(js);console.log('Build check OK');"
